units.Analicé 6.030 anuncios de Airbnb en el P: I analysed 6,030 Airbnb listings in the Basque Country, starting with territory rather than price.
units.Entender un mercado antes de mirar el pr: Understanding a market before looking at price.
units.Quise analizar cómo es realmente el merc: I wanted to analyse what the Airbnb market in the Basque Country is really like, using public data. Instead of stopping at the average price, I explored how supply changes with territory, type of accommodation and host profile.
units.Este proyecto reúne todo el proceso: lim: This project brings the whole process together: data cleaning, modelling, analysis and a Power BI dashboard designed to answer real questions.
units.Leer el mercado por territorio antes que: Reading the market by territory before price.
units.Lo primero que hice fue entender el tama: The first thing I did was understand the size of the market. Before calculating prices or trends, I needed to know how many properties there were, how many hosts took part and how supply was spread.
units.Esa visión inicial me permitió interpret: That initial view helped me interpret the rest of the analysis better.
units.El mercado turístico es espacial antes q: The tourism market is spatial before it’s statistical.
units.Cuando llevé los datos al mapa apareció: When I put the data on the map, one of the first important differences appeared: supply wasn’t evenly distributed.
units.Había zonas con mucha concentración de a: Some areas had a high concentration of properties, and others much less activity. Seeing that distribution before getting into prices changed the way I read the market.
units.Por eso decidí construir el análisis emp: That’s why I decided to build the analysis starting from territory, not from the average.
This is how I summarised the market’s distribution.
units.Construí un esquema en estrella para ana: I built a star schema to analyse the market in context.
units.Después de limpiar los datos diseñé un m: After cleaning the data, I designed a star schema in Power BI, organising the information into a fact table and several connected dimensions.
units.Esta estructura hace que el análisis sea: This structure makes the analysis more consistent, makes calculating metrics in DAX easier and lets you move between territory, accommodation and time without losing the context of each figure.

units.Los filtros mantienen el contexto entre: Filters keep their context across pages, so you can move from an executive summary to a detailed map without losing the thread of the analysis.

units.La señal que no aparecía en la media del: The signal that didn’t show up in the market average.
units.La media del mercado escondía una concen: The market average was hiding a very clear concentration.
units.Al analizar la distribución de los anunc: Analysing how listings were distributed, I found that just 31 hosts, around 0.8% of the total, managed more than 15% of all supply.
units.Ese dato cambió la lectura del mercado:: That figure changed how I read the market: not all hosts take part in the same way. Some manage far more than the rest, something that only appeared when crossing territory, type of accommodation and the distribution of listings.
units.Cuatro cosas que el precio medio no expl: Four things the average price doesn’t explain.
units.Al mapear los alojamientos comprobé que: Mapping the properties, I saw that activity wasn’t spread evenly. Some areas concentrated a large share of supply, while others had a much smaller presence.
units.Al analizar los anfitriones apareció una: Analysing the hosts revealed an important difference between those who manage a single property and those who run several listings.
units.La mayor parte de la oferta corresponde: Most of the supply is entire homes, although the proportion changes with the territory.
units.Al cruzar variables aparecieron segmento: Crossing variables revealed small segments that go unnoticed when you only look at the market average.
units.Diseño pensado para facilitar la lectura: Design built to make reading easier.
units.Qué me llevo del proyecto: What I take away from the project
The model found two real errors.
units.Durante el proceso aparecieron dos probl: During the process, two problems came up that could have changed the reading of the analysis if they hadn’t been fixed.
units.El primero estaba relacionado con regist: The first had to do with duplicate records that inflated some metrics.
units.El segundo surgió al revisar la relación: The second appeared when reviewing the relationship between hosts and listings, where part of the market’s concentration stayed hidden if only general aggregations were used.
units.Resolver ambos casos me obligó a validar: Solving both forced me to validate the model before building the dashboard.
units.Fue una buena lección: una visualización: It was a good lesson: a visual can look good and still rest on a wrong calculation.
